conversation: This story is about director of school, he was walking from the office to car last night, when suddenly he was attacked. Now he is bed ridden in the hospital and the police are asking him about the happening.

Last time at 9:18, the director of school was walking from his office to his car when he was attacked from behind. The attacker hit the director on the head. The police think the attacker was student, maybe a girl student. The police are gonna interview every student. A police man interviewed the director at the hospital last night.
A: Well Mr. Snow, what can you remember about the attack?
B: I was working late yesterday.
A: What time did you leave your office?
B: Oh, yes. I looked at my watch.
A: What did you do then?
B: I locked the door. Then I was walking to my car when suddenly somebody hit me on the head.
A: Did you see the attacker?
B: No, he was wearing stocking over his head.
A: Now tell me Mr. Snow. How did you break your leg?
B: When they were putting me into the ambulance, they dropped me.
